items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets ETR record ceiling projection of 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate.
With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead PIT RBs; expect heavy checkdowns from Rodgers as vertical game struggling. Projecting Warren in despite Q. Backups Homer/Heidenreich.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week w/ Collins out; IND allows 4th-most TE yards.
Davante Adams 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%; prior games 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and 16-5 touches rest of game; still ranks Stevenson ahead W3 as gap narrowed but pass pro trust issue.
items.implication: Henderson rising but Stevenson still preferred
